memory: Daycare: Drop-off at 8 AM, pick-up at 5 PM. Monthly payment due Friday. Bring extra set of clothes—last set got muddy.Elementary school: Finalize admission paperwork. Attend orientation next Thursday. Research after-school programs.Doctor: Kid’s cold isn’t getting better—schedule pediatrician visit. Check vaccine schedule—next shots due in two months. Monitor food allergies—keep a log if symptoms flare up.Family time: Take kid to park this weekend. Pick out a new bedtime story book. Help with counting practice—teacher says focus on numbers 1-20.Shopping: Buy more diapers. Get school supplies—crayons, notebooks, glue sticks. Pack extra snacks in daycare bag.Schedule bloodwork for annual physical next month.Call dentist for an appointment opening.Look into getting an eye exam due to straining at screens lately.Schedule gym workouts at least 3 times this week, focusing on strength training for legs and back. Also, try to hit 10,000 steps daily and remember to stretch before bed, especially hamstrings which are too tight.Cut back on sugar intake by reducing soda consumption. Prepare meals on Sundays by grilling chicken, cooking quinoa, and preparing vegetables. Aim to drink at least 3L of water per day and consider taking a protein shake after workouts.Aim for 7+ hours of sleep per night and limit screen time before bed. Schedule a day off next month to avoid back-to-back work. Also, make time for hobbies, such as picking up the guitar again.Take Vitamin D3 supplements at a dosage of 1000 IU per day. Consider taking Omega-3 supplements for joint health. Remember to take iron supplements to maintain healthy iron levels, as they were low during the last check-up. Also, take probiotics in the morning to help with digestion.
